# HugeGraph Documentation Map
> Machine-readable index for LLM ingestion and contributor onboarding.
> Inspired by Gbrain's llms.txt pattern.

## Project Overview
Apache HugeGraph is a fast-speed and highly-scalable graph database supporting
billions of vertices and edges. Compliant with Apache TinkerPop 3, supports
Gremlin and Cypher query languages.

- Language: Java 11+
- Build: Apache Maven 3.5+
- Graph Framework: Apache TinkerPop 3.5.1
- Default Backend: RocksDB
- Version: 1.7.0

## Key Source Paths
- Graph engine: hugegraph-server/hugegraph-core/src/main/java/org/apache/hugegraph/
- REST APIs: hugegraph-server/hugegraph-api/src/main/java/org/apache/hugegraph/api/
- PD core: hugegraph-pd/hg-pd-core/src/main/java/org/apache/hugegraph/pd/
- Store core: hugegraph-store/hg-store-core/src/main/java/org/apache/hugegraph/store/
- PD protos: hugegraph-pd/hg-pd-grpc/src/main/proto/
- Store protos: hugegraph-store/hg-store-grpc/src/main/proto/

## Configuration Files
- Server: hugegraph-server/hugegraph-dist/src/assembly/static/conf/
  - hugegraph.properties (main server config)
  - rest-server.properties (REST API settings)
  - gremlin-server.yaml (Gremlin server)
- PD: hugegraph-pd/hg-pd-dist/src/assembly/static/conf/application.yml
- Store: hugegraph-store/hg-store-dist/src/assembly/static/conf/application.yml

## Build & Test Quick Reference
```bash
# Full build
mvn clean install -DskipTests

# Server tests (memory backend)
mvn test -pl hugegraph-server/hugegraph-test -am -P unit-test

# Server tests (RocksDB backend)
mvn test -pl hugegraph-server/hugegraph-test -am -P core-test,rocksdb

# PD tests (build struct first)
mvn install -pl hugegraph-struct -am -DskipTests
mvn test -pl hugegraph-pd/hg-pd-test -am

# Store tests
mvn test -pl hugegraph-store/hg-store-test -am
```

## Ecosystem Repositories
- hugegraph-toolchain: Loader, Hubble, Client SDK, Tools
- hugegraph-ai: LLM integration, Knowledge Graph, Graph RAG, Memory System
- hugegraph-computer: Distributed graph computing (OLAP)
- hugegraph-doc: Official documentation and website

## Memory System
The HugeGraph-AI Memory System (hugegraph-llm) enables registering code
repositories as knowledge graphs in HugeGraph, with incremental updates
and cross-repository RAG queries.

- Register: POST /memory/register
- Update: POST /memory/update (incremental)
- Query: POST /memory/query (cross-repo RAG)
- See: hugegraph-ai/hugegraph-llm/docs/memory-system-design.md
